g.text: Cost/time cover both designs; failure-rate bounds apply to each design.
L1/L2: one Opus pair each. *L1 averages historical jobs with transport interruptions.
L3/L4: ten RFEs per run; cost/time assume linear growth from the three-RFE pair.
Failure bounds use the approximate 95% zero-failure method, per design.
Budgets are not cumulative. Judge spend and quota waits are additional.
L5 can evaluate earlier outputs without waiting for L4.
